summary: Code quality is solid: TypeScript has explicit types/interfaces, error handling with ConfigError, pattern matching logic is sound. YAML uses pinned actions (checkout@v4) and reasonable permissions. Critical gaps: workflow hard-codes fixture paths (fixtures/active/*.json) that don't exist—workflow will crash at CLI step. Doesn't meet task requirements: test harness doesn't run through `act` with output captured to `act-result.txt` as specified; no test infrastructure shown (intentional per review scope, but still a gap). Glob matching, priority conflict resolution, and argument parsing are well-implemented but basic. Won't execute without fixture files.
